description.zh:
导播台ID。
- 如果您通过[CreateCaster接口](~~2848009~~)创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

- 如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过**直播控制台** > **导播台** > **云导播台**页面查看。

> 直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID。
description.en:
The production studio ID.

- If you created the production studio by calling the [CreateCaster](~~2848009~~) operation, use the CasterId value from the response.

- If you created the production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, go to the **ApsaraVideo Live console** > **Production Studio** > **Cloud Production Studios** page to view the ID.

> On the Cloud Production Studios page, the name of the production studio is its ID.

description.zh:
场景配置类型。取值：

- **Component**：组件配置。
- **Layout**：布局配置。
- **All**：组件和布局配置。
description.en:
The type of scene configuration to delete. Valid values:

- **Component**: The component configuration.

- **Layout**: The layout configuration.

- **All**: Both the component and layout configurations.

title.zh: 清除导播台的指定场景的配置信息

descriptions.zh:
调用本接口删除导播台场景配置。本接口目前支持的场景配置类型为组件配置、布局配置和组件和布局配置。


## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
This operation deletes the scene configuration of a production studio. You can delete the component configuration, the layout configuration, or both.

## QPS limit

The queries per second (QPS) limit for this operation is 10 calls per second per user. If you exceed this limit, your calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Plan your calls accordingly.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live delete-caster-scene-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --caster-id b4810848-bcf9-4aef-bd4a-e6bba2d90000 --scene-id b5f8c837-ceeb-424f-b30b-68e94e860000 --type Component --region cn-hangzhou
